tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen, tab bar and nav bar. Status bar uses light content. 16.9:1 with text.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Text field fill and grouped list rows (Settings).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, menus, snackbars and the claim ladder card: anything floating above bg.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Meter track on dark, disabled button fill, pressed list row.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows, under the nav bar and above the tab bar. Decorative only, never a control border.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders on dark: text fields, ghost buttons, the dashed add tile. 3.5:1 on surface-1.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg and surfaces.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary body text that must stay strong, e.g. meter labels on dark.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Mono labels, captions and supporting lines on dark. 8.2:1 on bg, 7.2:1 on surface-2.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Inactive tab icons and labels, chevrons. 6.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Field placeholder text only. 5.2:1 on bg.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, Scan, selected tab, switch on, focus ring, links on dark. Never used as text on paper.

tokens.name: lime-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of lime buttons (Android ripple base, iOS highlight).

tokens.name: lime-tint
tokens.usage: Android navigation-bar active indicator behind the selected icon.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lime. 14.9:1.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Time is running out, on dark: due counts, claim-day numbers, tab badges, error text on dark. 8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Text on signal-tint, e.g. the 25-item limit notice.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Background of due and limit notices on dark.

tokens.name: settled
tokens.usage: Settled or won claims on dark. 10.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Bills, receipts and countdown tickets: the objects people keep.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Documents: insurance policies, PUC, rent agreements, the claim form.

tokens.name: paper-rule
tokens.usage: Solid rules inside documents. Decorative.

tokens.name: paper-dash
tokens.usage: Dashed perforation rules inside receipts. Decorative (1.8:1), never a control border.

tokens.name: paper-track
tokens.usage: Meter track on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Item names and titles on paper.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Data and body text on paper, the document double rule, outline buttons on paper, covered meter fill. 14.3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Keys and labels on paper (BOUGHT, PAID). 5.7:1 on paper, 5.2:1 on paper-2.

tokens.name: due-ink
tokens.usage: Days-left text on paper when an item is due. 5.7:1 on paper.

tokens.name: stamp-due
tokens.usage: DUE stamp, and the due meter fill on paper (4.1:1 against paper-track).

tokens.name: stamp-covered
tokens.usage: COVERED and ACTIVE stamps on paper. 5.0:1 on paper-2. Darker than the web's #2E7D4F, which missed 4.5:1 on paper-2.

tokens.name: stamp-expired
tokens.usage: EXPIRED stamp and expired meter fill. 4.9:1 on paper.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Top-level screen titles: iOS large title, Android large top app bar.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Android small top app bar, sheet titles, section heads.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Item names on receipt and document cards.

styles.name: ticket-number
styles.usage: The big number on a countdown ticket stub. Numbers only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We'll remind you 7 days before the return window closes.
styles.usage: Default reading text on both platforms.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Primary button labels and list-row titles.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Supporting lines on cards, rows and tickets.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: Read from your bill. Check it before saving.
styles.usage: Helper and error text under fields, timestamps.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE kickers, receipt keys, field labels and stamps.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Tab bar and navigation bar labels, uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Receipt rows, dates, reference and policy numbers.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: Amounts and days-left values on receipts.

styles.name: mono-button
styles.usage: Secondary and on-paper button labels, snackbar actions. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to badge, stamp padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, icon to label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in the vault list, field label to field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and sheet inner padding; Android screen margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen margin on iOS and the receipt inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields and between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a section title; receipt bottom padding over the zigzag.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom inset so the last card clears the FAB or tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Stamps and document cards (policies, agreements).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, chips, receipts and tickets. The default.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Android FAB, snackbars, the iOS scan button.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switches, tab badges and the Android nav indicator only.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: Lifts receipts, documents and tickets off the dark ground. On native, a drop shadow in iOS, elevation 3 on Android.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-fab
tokens.usage: Android FAB and snackbars.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable on both platforms (above iOS's 44pt minimum).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of primary buttons and text fields.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Tab, nav and row icons, 2px stroke.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and chips.

tokens.name: appbar-ios
tokens.usage: iOS navigation bar (large title adds 52pt below).

tokens.name: appbar-android
tokens.usage: Android small top app bar.

tokens.name: tabbar-ios
tokens.usage: iOS tab bar, plus the home-indicator safe area.

tokens.name: navbar-android
tokens.usage: Android navigation bar, plus the gesture-bar inset.

tokens.name: fab
tokens.usage: Android extended FAB height.
